description: This Java test class 'CreateCoreUuids' is a helper utility for generating Liquibase XML update scripts that assign UUIDs to various core metadata entities in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It retrieves different types of core metadata objects, relationship types, roles, and users via OpenMRS APIs and prints out XML snippets to update their UUID fields in the database for synchronization purposes.

classes.name: CreateCoreUuids
classes.description: A helper test class that generates Liquibase XML snippets to assign UUIDs to core metadata entities in the OpenMRS database for synchronization purposes.

methods.name: getUUIDs
methods.description: Main method that retrieves core metadata, relationship types, roles, and users, then outputs XML scripts to update their UUIDs in the database.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Overrides the base method to specify that a persistent database should be used instead of an in-memory HSQL database during tests.
